headlines.description: — Keider Montero pitched three-hit ball into the seventh inning and the Detroit Tigers blanked the Cleveland Guardians 3-0 on Thursday despite failing to record a strikeout.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montero, Tigers shut out Guardians without a strikeout, a first in MLB since 2014

headlines.description: — Braxton Ashcraft threw a complete-game three-hitter, Rafael Flores had a pair of three-run homers and the Pittsburgh Pirates beat the Miami Marlins 13-1 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ashcraft throws complete game, Flores has 2 homers, 6 RBIs as Pirates rout Marlins 13-1

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Sal Stewart, Eugenio Suárez and Tyler Stephenson homered, and the Cincinnati Reds held off the Chicago White Sox for a 9-8 victory on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sal Stewart homers as Reds hold off Chicago White Sox for a 9-8 win

events.name: Seattle Mariners at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Logan Gilbert pitched six innings and combined with three relievers on a four-hitter as the Seattle Mariners ended a six-game skid with a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Logan Gilbert pitches 6 strong innings as Mariners stop 6-game skid with 1-0 win over Yankees

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Standout rookie Payton Tolle allowed two hits over eight innings, Caleb Durbin hit a grand slam and the Boston Red Sox ended their five-game skid with a 7-0 victory over the Toronto Blue...
headlines.shortLinkText: Payton Tolle pitches 8-inning gem as Red Sox end 5-game skid with 7-0 win over Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Cade Cavalli took a no-hitter into the seventh inning, and the Washington Nationals beat the Chicago Cubs 7-0 on Thursday to avoid a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cade Cavalli takes a no-hitter into 7th inning as the Nationals rout the Cubs 7-0

headlines.description: — Kyle Schwarber smashed two home runs into the corn behind right field to stretch his major league -leading total to 37, as the Philadelphia Phillies beat the Minnesota Twins 7-1 on Thursday night in the first...
headlines.shortLinkText: Phillies homer 3 times into the Field of Dreams corn in 7-1 win over Twins, with pair from Schwarber

events.name: Texas Rangers at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Walbert Ureña allowed two hits in six innings, Mike Trout and Denzer Guzman led a 15-hit outburst with three singles and an RBI apiece, and the Los Angeles Angels beat the Texas Rangers 7-0 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ureña pitches Angels past Rangers 7-0 as Trout and Guzman lead offense with 3 hits apiece

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Jake Bauers delivered the Brewers' third RBI single of the ninth inning with two outs, and Milwaukee rallied for a 5-4 victory over the Los Angeles Dodgers on Thursday night to stay alone atop the National League standings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers tag Edwin Diaz and rally for 3 runs in the 9th inning to beat the Dodgers 5-4
